name: Rajapalayam Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1936, Rajapalayam Mills Ltd manufactures cotton yarn and fabrics. It also generates electricity from its windmills for its captive requirements[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RML is the first venture of the Ramco group, which also has 5 other companies in the textile business. RML specializes in manufacturing yarn of finer counts ranging from 4s to 300s (single/double yarn), other value-added products such as mercerized, mélange, slub and gassed yarn.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.33 times its book value
Market value of investments Rs.3,176 Cr. is more than the Market Cap Rs.770 Cr.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.61% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 1.69% of profits over last 3 years
